summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K to furnish a press release dated August 2, 2026, in which Global CEO YT Jia shared a weekly investor update. The update highlights a monthly robotics sales record (152 units in July), the launch of an EAI Robotics Built in USA acceleration program, and a preview of an industry chain partner recruitment conference. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic events are disclosed. The filing is routine investor communications, not a special situation.
